verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises webhooks and generic third-party integrations that could relay approved feedback/specs into other systems, but there is no concrete evidence of a specific integration (e.g., Jira/Linear/GitHub) that pulls an approved spec into a delivery workflow for implementation. Missing for 10: documented integration with issue trackers/dev tools, evidence of spec-to-ticket sync, and any developer-facing workflow showing implementation kickoff from an approved post.
